title: Phase 3: verify and run commands with exit precedence
objective: Implement `fake-jev verify --url` as a thin control-API call and `fake-jev run -- <cmd>` with URL injection, ephemeral port, child lifecycle, post-run verification, and the exact exit-code precedence table.
nonGoals: no duplicated verification logic in the CLI
nextAction: merge FJ-032 into main and re-verify the combined state
notes: scope amendment 2026-09-30 (PM): added internal/cli/dispatch.go so verify and run are routable; internal/cli/serve.go so `run` reuses the serve lifecycle (ephemeral port, ready file, graceful shutdown) instead of forking it; internal/cli/verify_test.go for verify-specific tests; internal/host/http/server.go because the hardener flagged that the FJ-032 run lifecycle may need an explicit host seam. Pre-empted from the FJ-031 hardener's recorded F5 rather than stalling a worker mid-flight.
